lesson.learning_objective: See that doubling a 3-4-5 triangle gives 6² + 8² = 10² by counting unit squares.

definitions.meaning: the longest side, opposite the right angle

steps: Start from the 3-4-5 right triangle and double every side to get 6, 8 and 10.
Build a square on each side and count its unit squares: 36, 64 and 100.
The two smaller squares together hold exactly as many unit squares as the largest one.
examples: Doubling the sides multiplies every area by 4: 9 → 36, 16 → 64, 25 → 100.
